identity.title: The Art of Pokémon Adventures 2016 Con Exclusive

leadText:
The Art of Pokémon Adventures 2016 Con Exclusive (Japanese: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL イラスト集: PokeSP Illustrations Pocket Monsters SPECIAL Illustrations) is a mini art book featuring full-color illustrations by Satoshi Yamamoto for the Pokémon Adventures . It includes 68 illustrations numbered #00 through #67 across 64 pages, twelve of which were not previously published (#00, #02, #25, #27, #28, #36, #38, #42, #44, #46, #47, and #53). 

In Japan, the book was included as a supplement with the limited edition release of in 2014. In North America, the book was sold for $15 at the VIZ Media booth at the 2016 and 2016. In mainland China, the book and 12 postcards were included as a bonus with the – boxed set.
